g.text: All 20 JPA entity classes; selected declared fields shown with exact Java names/types.
Associations show actual entity references and collection names, not role inheritance.
Composition marks JPA CascadeType.ALL; Cart.items and Product.images also remove orphans.
Constructors, accessors and routine lifecycle timestamps are omitted for readability.
Pattern-bearing services are in class-patterns.puml; every column is in er-schema.puml.
